notes_for_editor: Keeper lists conflict: Association/LighthouseFriends vs PEI Lighthouse Society (David Byron 1853-87, William Archie MacDonald 1887-1908, Colin Steele 1908-10); Marine Dept tables (Steele appointed 3 June 1901) support the Association. Creed's end date is 1967, 1981 or 1981 by source. Appointment dates for Steele and Condon were matched by column position in OCR tables (vols 38 and 45). The 1906 Minto entry spells the island 'Panmore'; assumed Panmure. Marine report volume labels (1909 vol 43 for the fog alarm) were not matched to fiscal years; the 1908 fog-alarm date comes from LighthouseFriends and the Society and the report is cited only for the building. Hindenburg anecdote is a family recollection (route plausibility not checked). Dates of Steele (LF 1946 vs Society 1939). No newspapers or logs searched; no Canadian Coast Guard or provincial archive records read. Obituary on Find a Grave is a transcription of an unnamed newspaper. LighthouseFriends cited for facts only, paraphrased. Fact-check 2026-10-27: Steele/Condon matched by column position in vols 38 and 45; vol 45 (1911) lists Colin Steele at Panmure, which the story states as a disagreement with the Society's 1910 end date. Hindenburg recollection (about May 1937) postdates the 1936 retirement date; stated in text.
